units.source_text: 事實上，對於委派的任務我從不推辭，都是沉著應對，一一接受，

en.t: In fact, I never refused any task assigned to me; I calmly dealt with each one and accepted them all,

units.source_text: 也不曾因為舉止反常而遭到「狗」（同志們都這樣稱呼警察）的懷疑和盤問。

en.t: and I was never suspected or questioned by the “dogs” because I acted strangely, as the comrades called the police.

units.source_text: 我總是一臉笑容，也搞笑別人，準確無誤地完成他們交給我的所謂的危險任務（那些從事地下運動的傢伙，常常如臨大敵一樣地緊張，

en.t: I always smiled, made other people laugh, and accurately carried out the so-called dangerous tasks they gave me, while those underground movement people were always tense as if facing a grave crisis,

units.source_text: 有時還笨拙地模仿偵探小說，保持高度警惕。

en.t: and at times they even clumsily imitated detective novels and kept up an extreme state of alert.

units.source_text: 委託我做的任務都極其無聊，

en.t: The tasks entrusted to me were all exceedingly dull,

units.source_text: 卻煞有介事地製造出緊張的氣氛）。

en.t: yet they made a great show of creating an atmosphere of tension around them.

units.source_text: 就我當時的心情而言，就算成為黨員被捕，終身在牢獄度過也無怨無悔。

en.t: Given how I felt at the time, I would have had no regrets even if I had become a party member, been arrested, and spent my whole life in prison.
